boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Fresno State Library study environments, including quiet areas, reservable rooms, and media-production workspaces.

cards.title: Quiet Study Floor
cards.subtitle: Henry Madden Library · 2nd Floor, South Wing
cards.notes: Settle into a seat or table beyond the South Wing elevators, and keep conversation low. Bring only light snacks and covered drinks.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor with varied seating and tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library designates its Quiet Study Floor on the second-floor South Wing; it has a variety of seating options and tables.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Areas | Fresno State Library
cards.access_notes: No reservation is listed. Follow the library's quiet-study expectations and current building hours.

cards.title: Table Mountain Rancheria Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Henry Madden Library · Room 3110
cards.notes: Use the comfortable seating for quiet reading or focused laptop work; leave food and drinks outside this third-floor North Wing room.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet reading room with comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library designates the Table Mountain Rancheria Reading Room, Room 3110 on the third-floor North Wing, as a quiet study area.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Areas | Fresno State Library
cards.access_notes: No reservation is listed. No food or drink is allowed; observe quiet-area expectations and current building hours.

cards.title: Individual and Partner Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Henry Madden Library
cards.notes: Book a room for one or two people when you need a contained workspace, then save the confirmation and arrive within ten minutes.
cards.short_summary: Reservable private rooms for solo or paired work.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library offers Individual and Partner Study Rooms through its study-space booking system.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms and Spaces | Fresno State Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations are limited to Fresno State students and may be made up to four weeks ahead; rooms are limited to two hours per day and four hours per week.

cards.title: Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Henry Madden Library · 2nd and 3rd Floors, North Wing
cards.notes: Reserve an enclosed room for a project meeting, then use its whiteboard and monitor connections while staying within the posted capacity.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed, reservable rooms with whiteboards and monitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library's Group Study Rooms are on the second and third floors of the North Wing, seat 8–10, and include whiteboards; most have large-screen monitors.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required. Fresno State students must follow current booking rules and posted room capacity.

cards.title: Group Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Henry Madden Library · 2nd Floor, North Wing
cards.notes: Reserve a pod for a compact team session and use the powered table and whiteboard to keep shared notes and devices organized.
cards.short_summary: Reservable pods for up to six people with powered tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library's Group Study Pods are on the second-floor North Wing, have capacity for six, and include whiteboards and powered tables.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required. Fresno State students must follow current booking rules and posted pod capacity.

cards.title: Music and Media
cards.subtitle: Henry Madden Library · 3rd Floor, North Wing
cards.notes: Work with collaborators at powered tables or study carrels, and reserve a workstation if you need one of the available student computers.
cards.short_summary: An open collaboration space with computers, tables, and carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library describes Music and Media as an open study space encouraging group collaboration, with eight student computers, powered tables, regular tables, and study carrels.
cards.access_notes: The room has shorter hours than the library building. Reserve a workstation when needed; only bottled water is permitted.

cards.title: Media Lab
cards.subtitle: Music and Media · 3rd Floor, North Wing
cards.notes: Ask at the Music and Media service desk before using this lab for image or video projects, then reserve a workstation for your session.
cards.short_summary: A specialized media-editing lab within Music and Media.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library's Media Lab in Music and Media provides specialized video and image-editing software, including Adobe Creative Cloud.
cards.source_title: Media Labs / Library Computers | Fresno State Library
cards.access_notes: Ask at the Music and Media service desk for access and reserve a workstation; current booking policies apply.

cards.title: Music Lab
cards.subtitle: Music and Media · 3rd Floor, North Wing
cards.notes: Reserve a workstation for audio-focused coursework, then ask the Music and Media desk for access to the editing and conversion stations.
cards.short_summary: A music-production workspace with editing stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library's Music Lab in Music and Media has music-editing stations and analog-converting stations.
cards.source_title: Media Labs / Library Computers | Fresno State Library
cards.access_notes: Ask at the Music and Media service desk for access and reserve a workstation; current booking policies apply.

cards.title: Video Studio 3113A
cards.subtitle: Music and Media · 3rd Floor, North Wing
cards.notes: Reserve this studio for a course video or streamed project, and bring your own SD card or flash drive to move recorded files efficiently.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library's Video Studio 3113A has capacity for six and includes a camcorder, boom-arm microphone, LED lights, table, and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Only Fresno State students with eligible campus email addresses may reserve it; bring a reservation confirmation and follow posted policies.

cards.title: Video Studio 3113B
cards.subtitle: Music and Media · 3rd Floor, North Wing
cards.notes: Book this studio for a small production session, and use the camera, microphone, and lights for a focused recording or cross-curricular project.
cards.short_summary: A second six-person video-production studio with recording equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Library's Video Studio 3113B has capacity for six and includes a camcorder, boom-arm microphone, LED lights, table, and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Only Fresno State students with eligible campus email addresses may reserve it; bring a reservation confirmation and follow posted policies.
